BuildCache.buildDependencies.summary.en:
An array of files containing build dependencies.
Rspack will use the hash of each of these files to invalidate the persistent cache.
BuildCache.buildDependencies.summary.text:
包含构建依赖的文件数组。
Rspack 会使用其中每个文件的 hash 来使持久化缓存失效。

BuildCache.buildDependencies.default.en: `['package.json', 'tsconfig.json' (or source.tsconfigPath), '.env', '.env.*', 'tailwindcss.config.*']`; when using the Rspeedy CLI with `performance.buildCache` enabled, the loaded `lynx.config.*` file is also added.
BuildCache.buildDependencies.default.text: `['package.json', 'tsconfig.json' (or source.tsconfigPath), '.env', '.env.*', 'tailwindcss.config.*']`；使用 Rspeedy CLI 且启用了 `performance.buildCache` 时，还会添加当前加载的 `lynx.config.*` 文件。

BuildCache.cacheDigest.summary.en:
Add additional cache digests, the previous build cache will be invalidated
when any value in the array changes.
BuildCache.cacheDigest.summary.text:
添加额外的缓存摘要，当数组中的任意值发生变化时，
之前的构建缓存将会失效。

BuildCache.cacheDirectory.summary.en: The output directory of the cache files.

BundleFilenameContext.summary.en: The context passed to the [`Filename.bundle`](api:Filename.bundle) function.
BundleFilenameContext.summary.text: 传递给 [`Filename.bundle`](api:Filename.bundle) 函数的上下文。

BundleFilenameContext.entryName.summary.en:
The name of the entry.

It is `undefined` for lazy bundles, since a lazy bundle name is resolved
per async chunk (use the `[name]` placeholder in the returned string
instead).
BundleFilenameContext.entryName.summary.text:
入口的名称。

对于 lazy bundle，该值为 `undefined`，因为 lazy bundle 的名称是按每个
异步 chunk 解析的（请改为在返回的字符串中使用
`[name]` 占位符）。

BundleFilenameContext.lazyBundle.summary.en:
Whether the filename is being resolved for a lazy bundle (async chunk)
instead of the main bundle of an entry.

This allows you to control the main bundle and the lazy bundles with a
single function, without needing a dedicated `lazyBundle` field.
BundleFilenameContext.lazyBundle.summary.text:
当前解析的文件名是否属于 lazy bundle（异步 chunk），
而非某个入口的主 bundle。

这样你可以用单个函数同时控制主 bundle 和 lazy bundle，
而无需专门的 `lazyBundle` 字段。

ChunkSplit.summary.text:
`Performance.chunkSplit`

 请改用顶层的 [`Config.splitChunks`](api:Config.splitChunks) 选项。

ChunkSplit.override.summary.en: Custom Rspack chunk splitting config can be specified.
ChunkSplit.override.summary.text: 可以指定自定义的 Rspack chunk 拆分配置。

ChunkSplit.strategy.remarks.en:
- `split-by-experience`(Rsbuild default): an empirical splitting strategy, automatically splits some commonly used npm packages into chunks of moderate size.

- `split-by-module`: split by NPM package granularity, each NPM package corresponds to a chunk.

- `split-by-size`: automatically split according to module size.

- `all-in-one`: bundle all codes into one chunk.

- `single-vendor`: bundle all NPM packages into a single chunk.

- `custom`: custom chunk splitting strategy.
ChunkSplit.strategy.remarks.text:
- `split-by-experience`（Rsbuild 默认）：根据经验制定的拆分策略，自动将一些常用的 npm 包拆分为体积适中的 chunk。

- `split-by-module`：按 NPM 包的粒度拆分，每个 NPM 包对应一个 chunk。

- `split-by-size`：根据模块大小自动拆分。

- `all-in-one`：将所有代码打包到一个 chunk 中。

- `single-vendor`：将所有 NPM 包打包到单个 chunk 中。

- `custom`：自定义 chunk 拆分策略。

ChunkSplit.strategy.default.en: In Rsbuild's default chunk splitting behavior, the strategy is `'split-by-experience'`.
ChunkSplit.strategy.default.text: 在 Rsbuild 默认的 chunk 拆分行为中，策略为 `'split-by-experience'`。

ChunkSplitBySize.summary.text:
`Performance.chunkSplit`

 请改用顶层的 [`Config.splitChunks`](api:Config.splitChunks) 选项。

ChunkSplitBySize.maxSize.summary.en: The maximum size of a chunk, unit in bytes.
ChunkSplitBySize.maxSize.summary.text: chunk 的最大体积，单位为字节。

ChunkSplitBySize.minSize.summary.en: The minimum size of a chunk, unit in bytes.
ChunkSplitBySize.minSize.summary.text: chunk 的最小体积，单位为字节。

ChunkSplitCustom.summary.text:
`Performance.chunkSplit`

 请改用顶层的 [`Config.splitChunks`](api:Config.splitChunks) 选项。

Config.summary.en: The `Config` is the configuration that `rspeedy` uses.

Config.dev.summary.en: The [`Dev`](api:Dev) option is used to control the behavior related with development. Including: HMR, DevServer, etc.
Config.dev.summary.text: [`Dev`](api:Dev) 选项用于控制与开发相关的行为，包括 HMR、DevServer 等。

Config.environments.summary.en: The [`Config.environments`](api:Config.environments) option is used to set the output environment.
Config.environments.summary.text: [`Config.environments`](api:Config.environments) 选项用于设置输出的 environment。

Config.environments.remarks.en: Normally you don't need this if you are not using Lynx for Web.
Config.environments.remarks.text: 如果你没有使用 Lynx for Web，通常不需要此选项。

Config.environments.default.en: When this option is unset, Rspeedy passes `{ lynx: {} }` to Rsbuild.
Config.environments.default.text: 未设置该选项时，Rspeedy 会向 Rsbuild 传入 `{ lynx: {} }`。

Config.mode.summary.en: Specify the build mode for Rsbuild and Rspack, as each mode has different default behavior and optimizations.
Config.mode.summary.text: 指定 Rsbuild 和 Rspack 的构建模式，不同模式有不同的默认行为和优化。

Config.mode.default.en:
Depends on `process.env.NODE_ENV`:

- `'production'` when `NODE_ENV` is `'production'`
- `'development'` when `NODE_ENV` is `'development'`
- `'none'` otherwise

With Rspeedy's CLI, `rspeedy dev` and `rspeedy preview` default to `'development'`, and `rspeedy build` defaults to `'production'`.
Config.mode.default.text:
取决于 `process.env.NODE_ENV`：

- `NODE_ENV` 为 `'production'` 时为 `'production'`
- `NODE_ENV` 为 `'development'` 时为 `'development'`
- 其他情况为 `'none'`

使用 Rspeedy CLI 时，`rspeedy dev` 和 `rspeedy preview` 默认为 `'development'`，`rspeedy build` 默认为 `'production'`。

Config.output.summary.en: The [`Output`](api:Output) option is used to set how and where should the bundles and assets output.
Config.output.summary.text: [`Output`](api:Output) 选项用于设置 bundle 和静态资源的输出方式与输出位置。

Config.performance.summary.en: The [`Performance`](api:Performance) option is used to optimize the build-time and runtime performance.
Config.performance.summary.text: [`Performance`](api:Performance) 选项用于优化构建时和运行时的性能。

Config.plugins.summary.en: The `plugins` option is used to customize the build process in a variety of ways.
Config.plugins.summary.text: `plugins` 选项用于以多种方式自定义构建流程。

Config.plugins.remarks.en: Rspeedy uses the plugin APIs from [Rsbuild](https://rsbuild.rs/plugins/dev/index). See the corresponding document for developing a plugin.
Config.plugins.remarks.text: Rspeedy 使用 [Rsbuild](https://rsbuild.rs/plugins/dev/index) 的插件 API。开发插件请参阅相应文档。

Config.resolve.summary.en: The [`Resolve`](api:Resolve) option is used to control the resolution behavior of Rspack.
Config.resolve.summary.text: [`Resolve`](api:Resolve) 选项用于控制 Rspack 的模块解析行为。

Config.server.summary.en: The [`Server`](api:Server) option changes the behavior of dev-server.
Config.server.summary.text: [`Server`](api:Server) 选项用于修改开发服务器的行为。

Config.source.summary.en: The [`Source`](api:Source) option changes the behavior of source files.
Config.source.summary.text: [`Source`](api:Source) 选项用于修改源文件相关的行为。

Config.splitChunks.default.en:
Rspeedy defaults this to `false`; if configured, Rsbuild handles it with its top-level `splitChunks` option.

See [Rsbuild - splitChunks](https://rsbuild.rs/config/split-chunks) for details.
Config.splitChunks.default.text:
Rspeedy 默认将其设置为 `false`；如果进行了配置，则由 Rsbuild 的顶层 `splitChunks` 选项处理。

详见 [Rsbuild - splitChunks](https://rsbuild.rs/config/split-chunks)。

Config.tools.summary.en: The [`Tools`](api:Tools) options changes the behavior of various building tools.
Config.tools.summary.text: [`Tools`](api:Tools) 选项用于修改各类构建工具的行为。

ConfigParams.summary.en: Parameters for the function exported from `lynx.config.js`.

ConfigParams.command.default.en: When `loadConfig` evaluates a config function, this value is `process.argv[2] ?? 'build'`
ConfigParams.command.default.text: 当 `loadConfig` 执行配置函数时，该值为 `process.argv[2] ?? 'build'`

ConfigParams.env.default.en: When `loadConfig` evaluates a config function, this value is `process.env.NODE_ENV ?? 'production'`
ConfigParams.env.default.text: 当 `loadConfig` 执行配置函数时，该值为 `process.env.NODE_ENV ?? 'production'`

CreateRspeedyOptions.callerName.summary.en:
The name of the framework or tool that is currently invoking Rsbuild.
This allows plugins to tailor their behavior based on the calling context.
CreateRspeedyOptions.callerName.summary.text:
当前调用 Rsbuild 的框架或工具的名称。
插件可以据此根据调用上下文调整自身行为。

CreateRspeedyOptions.cwd.summary.en: The root path of the current build.

CreateRspeedyOptions.environment.summary.en:
Only build specified environments.
For example, passing `['lynx']` will only build the `lynx` environment.
If not specified or passing an empty array, all environments will be built.
CreateRspeedyOptions.environment.summary.text:
仅构建指定的 environment。
例如，传入 `['lynx']` 将只构建 `lynx` environment。
如果未指定或传入空数组，则会构建所有 environment。

CreateRspeedyOptions.loadEnv.summary.en:
Rspeedy automatically loads the .env file by default, utilizing the [Rsbuild API](https://rsbuild.rs/api/javascript-api/core#load-env-variables).
You can use the environment variables defined in the .env file within your code by accessing them via `import.meta.env.FOO` or `process.env.Foo`.
CreateRspeedyOptions.loadEnv.summary.text:
Rspeedy 默认会通过 [Rsbuild API](https://rsbuild.rs/api/javascript-api/core#load-env-variables) 自动加载 .env 文件。
你可以在代码中通过 `import.meta.env.FOO` 或 `process.env.Foo` 访问 .env 文件中定义的环境变量。

CssExtractRspackLoaderOptions.esModule.s.en:
The same as [https://github.com/webpack-contrib/mini-css-extract-plugin#esModule](https://github.com/webpack-contrib/mini-css-extract-plugin#esModule).
By default, `@lynx-js/css-extract-webpack-plugin` generates JS modules that use the ES modules syntax.
There are some cases in which using ES modules is beneficial,
like in the case of module concatenation and tree shaking.
CssExtractRspackLoaderOptions.esModule.s.text:
与 [https://github.com/webpack-contrib/mini-css-extract-plugin#esModule](https://github.com/webpack-contrib/mini-css-extract-plugin#esModule) 相同。
默认情况下，`@lynx-js/css-extract-webpack-plugin` 会生成使用 ES modules 语法的 JS 模块。
在某些情况下使用 ES modules 会更有优势，
例如模块合并（module concatenation）和 tree shaking。

CssLoader.importLoaders.summary.en: The option `importLoaders` allows you to configure how many loaders before `css-loader` should be applied to `@imported` resources and CSS modules imports.
CssLoader.importLoaders.summary.text: `importLoaders` 选项用于配置在 `css-loader` 之前，有多少个 loader 应用于 `@imported` 资源和 CSS Modules 导入。

CssLoader.importLoaders.default.en: `1` when compiling CSS files and `2` when compiling Sass or Less files
CssLoader.importLoaders.default.text: 编译 CSS 文件时为 `1`，编译 Sass 或 Less 文件时为 `2`

CssLoader.modules.summary.en: The [`cssLoader.modules`](api:CssLoaderModules) option enables/disables the CSS Modules specification and setup basic behavior.
CssLoader.modules.summary.text: [`cssLoader.modules`](api:CssLoaderModules) 选项用于启用/禁用 CSS Modules 规范，并设置基本行为。

CssLoader.modules.default.en: Enables CSS Modules with automatic `*.module.*` detection, camelCase exports, `namedExport: false`, and `localIdentName` inherited from `output.cssModules.localIdentName`.
CssLoader.modules.default.text: 启用 CSS Modules，自动识别 `*.module.*` 文件，使用 camelCase 导出、`namedExport: false`，`localIdentName` 继承自 `output.cssModules.localIdentName`。

CssLoaderModules.namedExport.summary.en: Enables/disables ES modules named export for locals.
CssLoaderModules.namedExport.summary.text: 启用/禁用 locals 的 ES modules 具名导出。

CssModules.auto.summary.en: The `auto` option allows CSS modules to be automatically enabled based on their filenames.
CssModules.auto.summary.text: `auto` 选项允许根据文件名自动启用 CSS Modules。

CssModules.auto.remarks.en:
Given the various `auto` values, the behavior is described as follows:

- `true`: enable CSS modules for all files matching `/\.module\.\w+$/i.test(filename)` RegExp.

- `false`: disable CSS modules.

- `RegExp`: enable CSS modules for all files matching the `auto.test(filename)` RegExp.

- `function`: enable CSS modules based on the filter function.

See [css-loader#auto](https://github.com/webpack-contrib/css-loader?tab=readme-ov-file#auto) for details.
CssModules.auto.remarks.text:
不同的 `auto` 值对应的行为如下：

- `true`：为所有匹配 `/\.module\.\w+$/i.test(filename)` 正则的文件启用 CSS Modules。

- `false`：禁用 CSS Modules。

- `RegExp`：为所有匹配 `auto.test(filename)` 正则的文件启用 CSS Modules。

- `function`：根据过滤函数启用 CSS Modules。

详见 [css-loader#auto](https://github.com/webpack-contrib/css-loader?tab=readme-ov-file#auto)。

CssModules.exportGlobals.summary.en: Allows exporting names from global class names, so you can use them via import.
CssModules.exportGlobals.summary.text: 允许从全局类名中导出名称，以便通过 import 使用。

CssModules.exportLocalsConvention.summar.en: The style of exported class names.

CssModules.exportLocalsConvention.remark.en:
Given the various `exportLocalsConvention` values, the behavior is described as follows:

- `'asIs'`:	Class names will be exported as is.

- `'camelCase'`: Class names will be camelized, the original class name will not to be removed from the locals

- `'camelCaseOnly'`: Class names will be camelized, the original class name will be removed from the locals

- `'dashes'`: Only dashes in class names will be camelized

- `'dashesOnly'`: Dashes in class names will be camelized, the original class name will be removed from the locals

See [css-loader#exportLocalsConvention](https://github.com/webpack-contrib/css-loader?tab=readme-ov-file#exportlocalsconvention) for details.
CssModules.exportLocalsConvention.remark.text:
不同的 `exportLocalsConvention` 值对应的行为如下：

- `'asIs'`：类名将按原样导出。

- `'camelCase'`：类名将转换为驼峰形式，原始类名不会从 locals 中移除

- `'camelCaseOnly'`：类名将转换为驼峰形式，原始类名将从 locals 中移除

- `'dashes'`：仅将类名中的短横线转换为驼峰形式

- `'dashesOnly'`：将类名中的短横线转换为驼峰形式，原始类名将从 locals 中移除

详见 [css-loader#exportLocalsConvention](https://github.com/webpack-contrib/css-loader?tab=readme-ov-file#exportlocalsconvention)。

CssModules.localIdentName.summary.en: Sets the format of the className generated by CSS Modules after compilation.
CssModules.localIdentName.summary.text: 设置 CSS Modules 编译后生成的 className 格式。

CssModules.localIdentName.remarks.en:
Available placeholders:

- `[local]`: Original class name

- `[hash]`: Hash of the class name

- `[path]`: File path

- `[name]`: File name

- `[ext]`: File extension

See [css-loader#localIdentName](https://github.com/webpack-contrib/css-loader?tab=readme-ov-file#localIdentName) for details.
CssModules.localIdentName.remarks.text:
可用的占位符：

- `[local]`：原始类名

- `[hash]`：类名的 hash

- `[path]`：文件路径

- `[name]`：文件名

- `[ext]`：文件扩展名

详见 [css-loader#localIdentName](https://github.com/webpack-contrib/css-loader?tab=readme-ov-file#localIdentName)。

Decorators.version.summary.en: Specify the decorator syntax version to be used.
Decorators.version.summary.text: 指定使用的装饰器语法版本。

Decorators.version.remarks.en: If you want to know the differences between different decorators versions, you can refer to: [How does this proposal compare to other versions of decorators?](https://github.com/tc39/proposal-decorators?tab=readme-ov-file#how-does-this-proposal-compare-to-other-versions-of-decorators)
Decorators.version.remarks.text: 如果你想了解不同装饰器版本之间的差异，可以参考：[How does this proposal compare to other versions of decorators?](https://github.com/tc39/proposal-decorators?tab=readme-ov-file#how-does-this-proposal-compare-to-other-versions-of-decorators)

Dev.assetPrefix.summary.en: The [`Dev.assetPrefix`](api:Dev.assetPrefix) is used to set the URL prefix for static assets during development.
Dev.assetPrefix.summary.text: [`Dev.assetPrefix`](api:Dev.assetPrefix) 用于设置开发环境下静态资源的 URL 前缀。

Dev.assetPrefix.remarks.en:
During `rspeedy dev`, if this option is not set to `false`, the dev plugin normalizes it to `http://<detected-host>:<port>/` and appends `server.base` when configured.

The functionality of [`Dev.assetPrefix`](api:Dev.assetPrefix) is basically the same as the [output.publicPath](https://rspack.rs/config/output#outputpublicpath)
config in Rspack. With the following differences:

- `dev.assetPrefix` only takes effect during development.

- `dev.assetPrefix` automatically appends a trailing `/` by default.

- The value of `dev.assetPrefix` is written to the `process.env.ASSET_PREFIX` environment variable.
Dev.assetPrefix.remarks.text:
在 `rspeedy dev` 期间，如果该选项未设置为 `false`，dev 插件会将其规范化为 `http://<detected-host>:<port>/`，并在配置了 `server.base` 时将其追加到末尾。

[`Dev.assetPrefix`](api:Dev.assetPrefix) 的功能与 Rspack 中的 [output.publicPath](https://rspack.rs/config/output#outputpublicpath)
配置基本相同，区别如下：

- `dev.assetPrefix` 仅在开发环境下生效。

- `dev.assetPrefix` 默认会自动在末尾添加 `/`。

- `dev.assetPrefix` 的值会写入 `process.env.ASSET_PREFIX` 环境变量。

Dev.hmr.summary.en: Whether to enable Hot Module Replacement (HMR).

Dev.hmr.remarks.en:
By default, Rspeedy uses HMR as the preferred method to update modules. If HMR is disabled or cannot be used in certain scenarios, it will automatically fallback to [`Dev.liveReload`](api:Dev.liveReload).

To completely disable both HMR and live reload, set both `dev.hmr` and `dev.liveReload` to `false`. Then, no WebSocket requests will be made to the dev server on the page, and the page will not automatically refresh when file changes.
Dev.hmr.remarks.text:
默认情况下，Rspeedy 优先使用 HMR 来更新模块。如果 HMR 被禁用或在某些场景下无法使用，将自动回退到 [`Dev.liveReload`](api:Dev.liveReload)。

如需完全禁用 HMR 和 live reload，请将 `dev.hmr` 和 `dev.liveReload` 都设置为 `false`。此时页面不会向开发服务器发起 WebSocket 请求，文件变化时页面也不会自动刷新。

Dev.liveReload.summary.en: Whether to enable live reload functionality.
Dev.liveReload.summary.text: 是否启用 live reload 功能。

Dev.liveReload.default.en:
true

Live reload is used as a fallback when [`Dev.hmr`](api:Dev.hmr) is disabled or cannot be used in certain scenarios. When enabled, the page will automatically refresh when source files are changed.

To completely disable both HMR and live reload, set both `dev.hmr` and `dev.liveReload` to `false`. Then, no WebSocket requests will be made to the dev server on the page, and the page will not automatically refresh when file changes.
Dev.liveReload.default.text:
true

当 [`Dev.hmr`](api:Dev.hmr) 被禁用或在某些场景下无法使用时，live reload 将作为回退方案。启用后，源文件变化时页面会自动刷新。

如需完全禁用 HMR 和 live reload，请将 `dev.hmr` 和 `dev.liveReload` 都设置为 `false`。此时页面不会向开发服务器发起 WebSocket 请求，文件变化时页面也不会自动刷新。

Dev.progressBar.summary.en: Whether to display progress bar during compilation.
Dev.progressBar.summary.text: 是否在编译过程中显示进度条。

Dev.watchFiles.summary.en: Watch specified files and directories for changes. When a file change is detected, it can trigger a page reload or restart the dev server.
Dev.watchFiles.summary.text: 监听指定文件和目录的变化。当检测到文件变化时，可以触发页面重新加载或重启开发服务器。

Dev.writeToDisk.summary.en: Used to control whether the build artifacts of the development environment are written to the disk.
Dev.writeToDisk.summary.text: 用于控制是否将开发环境的构建产物写入磁盘。

Dev.writeToDisk.remarks.en:
This is bypassed to [`webpack-dev-middleware`](https://github.com/webpack/webpack-dev-middleware?tab=readme-ov-file#writetodisk).

Setting `writeToDisk: true` won't change the behavior of the `webpack-dev-middleware`, and bundle files accessed through the browser will still be served from memory.

This option also accepts a `Function` value, which can be used to filter which files are written to disk.

The function follows the same premise as `Array#filter` in which a return value of `false` will not write the file, and a return value of `true` will write the file to disk.
Dev.writeToDisk.remarks.text:
该选项会透传给 [`webpack-dev-middleware`](https://github.com/webpack/webpack-dev-middleware?tab=readme-ov-file#writetodisk)。

设置 `writeToDisk: true` 不会改变 `webpack-dev-middleware` 的行为，通过浏览器访问的 bundle 文件仍然由内存提供。

该选项也接受 `Function` 类型的值，可用于过滤需要写入磁盘的文件。

该函数的逻辑与 `Array#filter` 相同：返回 `false` 时不写入该文件，返回 `true` 时将该文件写入磁盘。

EntryDescription.summary.en: The `EntryDescription` describes a entry. It is useful when the project has multiple entries with different configuration.
EntryDescription.summary.text: `EntryDescription` 用于描述一个入口。当项目中存在多个配置不同的入口时非常有用。

EntryDescription.remarks.en:
It is similar with the [Entry Description Object](https://rspack.rs/config/entry#entry-description-object) of Rspack.
But only a few properties that Lynx supports is allowed.
EntryDescription.remarks.text:
它与 Rspack 的 [Entry Description Object](https://rspack.rs/config/entry#entry-description-object) 类似。
但只允许使用 Lynx 支持的少数属性。

EntryDescription.dependOn.summary.en: The entry points that the current entry depends on. They must be loaded before this entry is loaded.
EntryDescription.dependOn.summary.text: 当前入口所依赖的入口，它们必须在当前入口加载之前加载。

EntryDescription.import.summary.en: The path to the entry module(s).

EntryDescription.publicPath.summary.en: This is an important option when using on-demand-loading or loading external resources like images, files, etc. If an incorrect value is specified you'll receive 404 errors while loading these resources.
EntryDescription.publicPath.summary.text: 在使用按需加载或加载图片、文件等外部资源时，这是一个重要的选项。如果指定了错误的值，加载这些资源时会出现 404 错误。

ExposedAPI.summary.en: The exposed API of Rspeedy. Can be used in Rsbuild plugin with [api.useExposed](https://rsbuild.rs/plugins/dev/core#apiuseexposed).
ExposedAPI.summary.text: Rspeedy 暴露的 API。可以在 Rsbuild 插件中通过 [api.useExposed](https://rsbuild.rs/plugins/dev/core#apiuseexposed) 使用。

ExposedAPI.entries.summary.en: Used for plugin qrcode get entry points from self-defined environments rather than default lynx environment.
ExposedAPI.entries.summary.text: 用于让 qrcode 插件从自定义的 environment 中获取入口，而不是从默认的 lynx environment 中获取。

Filename.assets.summary.en: The name of other assets, except for above (image, svg, font, html, wasm...)
Filename.assets.summary.text: 其他静态资源的名称，不包括上述类型（image、svg、font、html、wasm...）

Filename.bundle.remarks.en:
The following placeholder is supported:

- `[name]`: the name of the entry.
- `[contenthash]`: the contenthash of the bundle.
- `[platform]`: the environment name of the bundle.
Filename.bundle.remarks.text:
支持以下占位符：

- `[name]`：入口名称。
- `[contenthash]`：bundle 的 contenthash。
- `[platform]`：bundle 的 environment 名称。

Filename.css.summary.en: The name of the CSS files.

Filename.font.summary.en: The name of the font files.

Filename.image.summary.text: 非 SVG 图片的名称。

Filename.js.summary.en: The name of the JavaScript files.

Filename.js.default.en: `'[name].js'` in development, `'[name].[contenthash:8].js'` in production web builds, and `'[name].js'` in production node builds
Filename.js.default.text: 开发环境下为 `'[name].js'`，生产环境 web 构建为 `'[name].[contenthash:8].js'`，生产环境 node 构建为 `'[name].js'`

Filename.media.summary.en: The name of media assets, such as video.
Filename.media.summary.text: 媒体资源（如视频）的名称。

Filename.svg.summary.en: The name of the SVG images.

Filename.template.summary.en:
The name of the template files.



Use [`Filename.bundle`](api:Filename.bundle) instead.
Filename.template.summary.text:

请使用 [`Filename.bundle`](api:Filename.bundle) 代替。

Filename.template.remarks.en:

Filename.template.remarks.text:

- `[name]`：入口名称。
- `[contenthash]`：模板的 contenthash。

LoadConfigOptions.configPath.summary.en: The config file path to load.
LoadConfigOptions.configPath.summary.text: 要加载的配置文件路径。

LoadConfigOptions.configPath.default.text: 自动从 `cwd` 中解析 `lynx.config.ts`、`lynx.config.js`、`lynx.config.mts` 或 `lynx.config.mjs`

LoadConfigOptions.cwd.summary.en: The working directory used to resolve the config path.
LoadConfigOptions.cwd.summary.text: 用于解析配置文件路径的工作目录。

LoadConfigResult.configPath.summary.en: The configuration path that has been loaded.
LoadConfigResult.configPath.summary.text: 已加载的配置文件路径。

LoadConfigResult.content.summary.en: The configuration object that exported from the configuration file.
LoadConfigResult.content.summary.text: 从配置文件中导出的配置对象。

LoadConfigResult.content.remarks.en: The returned object has already been validated.
LoadConfigResult.content.remarks.text: 返回的对象已经过校验。

Minify.backgroundOptions.summary.en:
[`Minify.backgroundOptions`](api:Minify.backgroundOptions) is used to override
[`Minify.jsOptions`](api:Minify.jsOptions) for background-thread bundles.
Minify.backgroundOptions.summary.text:
[`Minify.backgroundOptions`](api:Minify.backgroundOptions) 用于为后台线程 bundle 覆盖
[`Minify.jsOptions`](api:Minify.jsOptions)。

Minify.backgroundOptions.remarks.en:
This option is deep-merged into [`Minify.jsOptions`](api:Minify.jsOptions).
It is mainly used together with ReactLynx dual-thread outputs so that
main-thread and background-thread bundles can use different compress rules.
Minify.backgroundOptions.remarks.text:
该选项会被深度合并到 [`Minify.jsOptions`](api:Minify.jsOptions) 中。
它主要与 ReactLynx 的双线程产物配合使用，使
主线程和后台线程的 bundle 可以使用不同的压缩规则。

Minify.css.summary.text: 是否启用 CSS 压缩。

Minify.css.remarks.en: When building for production, [@rsbuild/plugin-css-minimizer](https://github.com/rspack-contrib/rsbuild-plugin-css-minimizer) is used to minify CSS assets for better transmission efficiency.
Minify.css.remarks.text: 在生产环境构建时，会使用 [@rsbuild/plugin-css-minimizer](https://github.com/rspack-contrib/rsbuild-plugin-css-minimizer) 压缩 CSS 资源，以提升传输效率。

Minify.css.default.en: When `output.minify` is enabled and `css` is unset, this defaults to `true`.
Minify.css.default.text: 当启用 `output.minify` 且未设置 `css` 时，默认为 `true`。

Minify.js.summary.text: 是否启用 JavaScript 压缩。

Minify.js.default.en: When `output.minify` is enabled and `js` is unset, this defaults to `true`.
Minify.js.default.text: 当启用 `output.minify` 且未设置 `js` 时，默认为 `true`。

Minify.jsOptions.summary.en: [`Minify.jsOptions`](api:Minify.jsOptions) is used to configure SWC minification options.
Minify.jsOptions.summary.text: [`Minify.jsOptions`](api:Minify.jsOptions) 用于配置 SWC 的压缩选项。

Minify.jsOptions.remarks.en: For detailed configurations, please refer to [SwcJsMinimizerRspackPlugin](https://rspack.rs/plugins/rspack/swc-js-minimizer-rspack-plugin).

Minify.jsOptions.default.en: When JavaScript minification is enabled and `jsOptions` is unset, this defaults to `{}`.
Minify.jsOptions.default.text: 当启用 JavaScript 压缩且未设置 `jsOptions` 时，默认为 `{}`。

Minify.mainThreadOptions.summary.en:
[`Minify.mainThreadOptions`](api:Minify.mainThreadOptions) is used to override
[`Minify.jsOptions`](api:Minify.jsOptions) for main-thread bundles.
Minify.mainThreadOptions.summary.text:
[`Minify.mainThreadOptions`](api:Minify.mainThreadOptions) 用于为主线程 bundle 覆盖
[`Minify.jsOptions`](api:Minify.jsOptions)。

Minify.mainThreadOptions.remarks.en:
This option is deep-merged into [`Minify.jsOptions`](api:Minify.jsOptions).
It is mainly used together with ReactLynx dual-thread outputs so that
main-thread and background-thread bundles can use different compress rules.
Minify.mainThreadOptions.remarks.text:
该选项会被深度合并到 [`Minify.jsOptions`](api:Minify.jsOptions) 中。
它主要与 ReactLynx 的双线程产物配合使用，使
主线程和后台线程的 bundle 可以使用不同的压缩规则。

Output.assetPrefix.summary.en: The [`Output.assetPrefix`](api:Output.assetPrefix) is used to set the URL prefix for static assets.
Output.assetPrefix.summary.text: [`Output.assetPrefix`](api:Output.assetPrefix) 用于设置静态资源的 URL 前缀。

Output.assetPrefix.remarks.en:
The functionality of [`Output.assetPrefix`](api:Output.assetPrefix) is basically the same as the [output.publicPath](https://rspack.rs/config/output#outputpublicpath)
config in Rspack. With the following differences:

- `output.assetPrefix` only takes effect in the production build.

- `output.assetPrefix` automatically appends a trailing `/` by default.

- The value of `output.assetPrefix` is written to the `process.env.ASSET_PREFIX` environment variable.
Output.assetPrefix.remarks.text:
[`Output.assetPrefix`](api:Output.assetPrefix) 的功能与 Rspack 的 [output.publicPath](https://rspack.rs/config/output#outputpublicpath)
配置基本相同，区别如下：

- `output.assetPrefix` 仅在生产环境构建时生效。

- `output.assetPrefix` 默认会自动在末尾添加 `/`。

- `output.assetPrefix` 的值会写入 `process.env.ASSET_PREFIX` 环境变量。

Output.cleanDistPath.summary.en: The [`Output.cleanDistPath`](api:Output.cleanDistPath) option determines whether all files in the output directory (default: `dist`) are removed before the build starts.
Output.cleanDistPath.summary.text: [`Output.cleanDistPath`](api:Output.cleanDistPath) 选项用于决定是否在构建开始前清空产物目录（默认为 `dist`）中的所有文件。

Output.cleanDistPath.remarks.en:
By default, if the output directory is a subdirectory of the project root path, Rspeedy will automatically clean all files in the build directory.

When [output.distPath.root](https://rsbuild.rs/config/output/dist-path#root-directory) is an external directory or the same as the project root directory, `cleanDistPath` is not enabled by default to prevent accidental deletion of files from other directories.
Output.cleanDistPath.remarks.text:
默认情况下，如果产物目录是项目根路径的子目录，Rspeedy 会自动清空构建目录中的所有文件。

当 [output.distPath.root](https://rsbuild.rs/config/output/dist-path#root-directory) 为外部目录或与项目根目录相同时，默认不会启用 `cleanDistPath`，以避免误删其他目录中的文件。

Output.cleanDistPath.default.en: Automatically enabled when `output.distPath.root` is a subdirectory of the project root; otherwise disabled.
Output.cleanDistPath.default.text: 当 `output.distPath.root` 为项目根目录的子目录时自动启用，否则禁用。

Output.copy.summary.en: The [`Output.copy`](api:Output.copy) option is used for copying files to the dist directory.
Output.copy.summary.text: [`Output.copy`](api:Output.copy) 选项用于将文件复制到产物目录。

Output.cssModules.summary.en: The [`CssModules`](api:CssModules) option is used for the customization of CSS Modules configurations.
Output.cssModules.summary.text: [`CssModules`](api:CssModules) 选项用于自定义 CSS Modules 配置。

Output.cssModules.remarks.en:
The CSS module is enabled for `*.module.css`, `*.module.scss` and `*.module.less`.
Use [`CssModules.auto`](api:CssModules.auto) to customize the filtering behavior.
Output.cssModules.remarks.text:
默认会为 `*.module.css`、`*.module.scss` 和 `*.module.less` 启用 CSS Modules。
使用 [`CssModules.auto`](api:CssModules.auto) 自定义过滤行为。

Output.dataUriLimit.summary.en: The [`Output.dataUriLimit`](api:Output.dataUriLimit) option is used to set the size threshold to inline static assets such as images and fonts.
Output.dataUriLimit.summary.text: [`Output.dataUriLimit`](api:Output.dataUriLimit) 选项用于设置图片、字体等静态资源内联的体积阈值。

Output.distPath.summary.en: Set the directory of the dist files.

Output.distPath.remarks.en: More options can be found at [Rsbuild - distPath](https://rsbuild.rs/config/output/dist-path).

Output.distPath.default.en: Uses Rsbuild's default distPath configuration with `root: 'dist'`.
Output.distPath.default.text: 使用 Rsbuild 默认的 distPath 配置，并设置 `root: 'dist'`。

Output.filename.summary.en: The [`Filename`](api:Filename) determines the name of the JavaScript bundle file to be output. These bundles will be written to the directory specified by output.path.
Output.filename.summary.text: [`Filename`](api:Filename) 决定输出的 JavaScript bundle 文件的名称。这些 bundle 会被写入 output.path 指定的目录中。

Output.filename.remarks.en: If a string is provided, it will be used as [`Filename.bundle`](api:Filename.bundle).
Output.filename.remarks.text: 如果传入字符串，它将被用作 [`Filename.bundle`](api:Filename.bundle)。

Output.filenameHash.summary.en: The [`Output.filenameHash`](api:Output.filenameHash) option controls whether to add a hash value to the filename after the production build.
Output.filenameHash.summary.text: [`Output.filenameHash`](api:Output.filenameHash) 选项用于控制生产环境构建后是否在文件名中添加 hash 值。

Output.filenameHash.default.en: In production web builds, Rsbuild defaults this option to `true`; development builds and non-web outputs omit hashes by default.
Output.filenameHash.default.text: 在生产环境 web 构建中，Rsbuild 默认将该选项设置为 `true`；开发环境构建和非 web 产物默认不添加 hash。

Output.inlineScripts.summary.en: The [`Output.inlineScripts`](api:Output.inlineScripts) option controls whether to inline scripts into Lynx bundle (`.lynx.bundle`).
Output.inlineScripts.summary.text: [`Output.inlineScripts`](api:Output.inlineScripts) 选项用于控制是否将脚本内联到 Lynx bundle（`.lynx.bundle`）中。

Output.inlineScripts.remarks.en:
This is different with [output.inlineScripts](https://rsbuild.rs/config/output/inline-scripts) since we normally want to inline scripts in Lynx bundle (`.lynx.bundle`).

There are two points that need to be especially noted:

1. Only background thread scripts can remain non-inlined, whereas the main thread script is always inlined.

2. Currently, when `experimental_isLazyBundle` is enabled, `inlineScripts` will always be `true`.
Output.inlineScripts.remarks.text:
这与 [output.inlineScripts](https://rsbuild.rs/config/output/inline-scripts) 不同，因为我们通常希望将脚本内联到 Lynx bundle（`.lynx.bundle`）中。

有两点需要特别注意：

1. 只有后台线程脚本可以不内联，主线程脚本始终会被内联。

2. 目前，当启用 `experimental_isLazyBundle` 时，`inlineScripts` 始终为 `true`。

Output.inlineScripts.default.en: Rspeedy defaults this to `true` and only switches it to `false` when the user explicitly enables the top-level `splitChunks` option.
Output.inlineScripts.default.text: Rspeedy 默认将其设置为 `true`，仅当用户显式启用顶层的 `splitChunks` 选项时才会切换为 `false`。

Output.legalComments.summary.en: The [`Output.legalComments`](api:Output.legalComments) controls how to handle the legal comment.
Output.legalComments.summary.text: [`Output.legalComments`](api:Output.legalComments) 用于控制如何处理法律注释（legal comment）。

Output.legalComments.remarks.en:
This is different with Rsbuild since we normally do not want a `.LEGAL.txt` file in Lynx outputs.

This behavior can be configured by using one of the following options:

- `linked`: Extract all legal comments to a `.LEGAL.txt` file and link to them with a comment.

- `inline`: Preserve all legal comments in original position.

- `none`: Remove all legal comments.
Output.legalComments.remarks.text:
这与 Rsbuild 不同，因为我们通常不希望 Lynx 产物中出现 `.LEGAL.txt` 文件。

可以通过以下选项之一配置该行为：

- `linked`：将所有法律注释提取到 `.LEGAL.txt` 文件中，并通过注释链接到该文件。

- `inline`：将所有法律注释保留在原位置。

- `none`：移除所有法律注释。

Output.minify.summary.en: The [`Minify`](api:Minify) configures whether to enable code minification in the production build, or to configure minimizer options.
Output.minify.summary.text: [`Minify`](api:Minify) 用于配置是否在生产环境构建中启用代码压缩，或配置压缩器选项。

Output.minify.default.text: 生产环境构建中为 `true`，其他情况为 `false`

Output.sourceMap.summary.en: The [`SourceMap`](api:SourceMap) configures whether and how to generate source-map for outputs.
Output.sourceMap.summary.text: [`SourceMap`](api:SourceMap) 用于配置是否为产物生成 source map，以及如何生成。

Output.sourceMap.default.en: When this option is unset in Lynx builds, JavaScript source maps use `'cheap-module-source-map'` in development and `'source-map'` in production; CSS source maps are also generated. All `.map` assets are removed before emit.
Output.sourceMap.default.text: 在 Lynx 构建中未设置该选项时，JavaScript source map 在开发环境使用 `'cheap-module-source-map'`，在生产环境使用 `'source-map'`；同时也会生成 CSS source map。所有 `.map` 资源都会在输出前被移除。

Performance.buildCache.summary.en: Enable or configure persistent build cache.
Performance.buildCache.summary.text: 启用或配置持久化构建缓存。

Performance.chunkSplit.summary.en: [`Performance.chunkSplit`](api:Performance.chunkSplit) is used to configure the chunk splitting strategy.
Performance.chunkSplit.summary.text: [`Performance.chunkSplit`](api:Performance.chunkSplit) 用于配置 chunk 拆分策略。

Performance.chunkSplit.default.en:
For web builds, Rsbuild currently uses `{ strategy: 'split-by-experience' }` when this option is unset.

 Use the top-level [`Config.splitChunks`](api:Config.splitChunks) option instead.
Performance.chunkSplit.default.text:
对于 web 构建，未设置该选项时 Rsbuild 当前使用 `{ strategy: 'split-by-experience' }`。

 请使用顶层的 [`Config.splitChunks`](api:Config.splitChunks) 选项代替。

Performance.printFileSize.summary.en: Whether to print the file sizes after production build.
Performance.printFileSize.summary.text: 是否在生产环境构建后打印文件大小。

Performance.profile.summary.en: Whether capture timing information in Lynx runtime integrations such as ReactLynx.
Performance.profile.summary.text: 是否在 ReactLynx 等 Lynx 运行时集成中采集耗时信息。

Performance.profile.default.en: Rspeedy sets this to `true` when `DEBUG` contains `rspeedy`; otherwise it leaves the option unset.
Performance.profile.default.text: 当 `DEBUG` 包含 `rspeedy` 时，Rspeedy 会将其设置为 `true`；否则不设置该选项。

Performance.profile.example.0.en:
Enable profile.

- Frameworks like ReactLynx will include runtime information using `console.profile`.
- Rspeedy will emit `dist/stats.json` after build for bundle analysis compatibility.

```ts
import { defineConfig } from '@lynx-js/rspeedy'

export default defineConfig({
  performance: { profile: true },
})
```
Performance.profile.example.0.text:
启用 profile。

- ReactLynx 等框架会通过 `console.profile` 输出运行时信息。
- Rspeedy 会在构建后输出 `dist/stats.json`，以兼容 bundle 分析工具。

```ts
import { defineConfig } from '@lynx-js/rspeedy'

export default defineConfig({
  performance: { profile: true },
})
```

Performance.removeConsole.summary.en: Whether to remove `console.[methodName]` in production build.
Performance.removeConsole.summary.text: 是否在生产环境构建中移除 `console.[methodName]`。

Resolve.alias.summary.en: Create aliases to `import` or `require` certain modules more easily.
Resolve.alias.summary.text: 创建别名，以便更方便地 `import` 或 `require` 某些模块。

Resolve.aliasStrategy.summary.en:
Set the strategy for path alias resolution, to control the priority relationship
between the `paths` option in `tsconfig.json` and the `resolve.alias` option of Rsbuild.
Resolve.aliasStrategy.summary.text:
设置路径别名解析的策略，用于控制 `tsconfig.json` 中的 `paths` 选项
与 Rsbuild 的 `resolve.alias` 选项之间的优先级关系。

Resolve.aliasStrategy.default.en:
`'prefer-tsconfig'`

- `prefer-tsconfig` (default): The `paths` option in `tsconfig.json` will take precedence over the
`resolve.alias` option of Rsbuild.
- `prefer-alias`: The `resolve.alias` option of Rsbuild will take precedence over the
`paths` option in `tsconfig.json`.
Resolve.aliasStrategy.default.text:
`'prefer-tsconfig'`

- `prefer-tsconfig`（默认）：`tsconfig.json` 中的 `paths` 选项优先于
Rsbuild 的 `resolve.alias` 选项。
- `prefer-alias`：Rsbuild 的 `resolve.alias` 选项优先于
`tsconfig.json` 中的 `paths` 选项。

Resolve.dedupe.summary.en: Force to resolve the specified packages from project root, which is useful for deduplicating packages and reducing the bundle size.
Resolve.dedupe.summary.text: 强制从项目根目录解析指定的包，可用于对包进行去重并减小 bundle 体积。

Resolve.dedupe.remarks.en:
[`Resolve.dedupe`](api:Resolve.dedupe) is implemented based on [`Resolve.alias`](api:Resolve.alias), it will get the path of the specified package through `require.resolve` in the project root directory and set it to the alias.

The alias generated by [`Resolve.dedupe`](api:Resolve.dedupe) will be merged with the configured [`Resolve.alias`](api:Resolve.alias) in the project, and the [`Resolve.alias`](api:Resolve.alias) config will take precedence when the keys are the same.
Resolve.dedupe.remarks.text:
[`Resolve.dedupe`](api:Resolve.dedupe) 基于 [`Resolve.alias`](api:Resolve.alias) 实现，它会在项目根目录下通过 `require.resolve` 获取指定包的路径，并将其设置为别名。

[`Resolve.dedupe`](api:Resolve.dedupe) 生成的别名会与项目中配置的 [`Resolve.alias`](api:Resolve.alias) 合并，当 key 相同时，[`Resolve.alias`](api:Resolve.alias) 配置的优先级更高。

Resolve.extensions.summary.en: Automatically resolve file extensions when importing modules. This means you can import files without explicitly writing their extensions.
Resolve.extensions.summary.text: 导入模块时自动解析文件扩展名。这意味着你可以在导入文件时省略扩展名。

Resolve.extensions.remarks.en:
The difference between `resolve.extensions` and `tools.rspack.resolve.extensions`:

`resolve.extensions`: Completely overrides Rspeedy's default resolution.

`tools.rspack.resolve.extensions`: Merges with the default configuration using [`webpack-merge`](https://github.com/survivejs/webpack-merge).
Resolve.extensions.remarks.text:
`resolve.extensions` 与 `tools.rspack.resolve.extensions` 的区别：

`resolve.extensions`：完全覆盖 Rspeedy 的默认解析配置。

`tools.rspack.resolve.extensions`：通过 [`webpack-merge`](https://github.com/survivejs/webpack-merge) 与默认配置合并。

Resolve.extensions.default.en:
`['.ts', '.tsx', '.mjs', '.js', '.jsx', '.json', '.cjs']`

For example, if importing './index', Rsbuild will try to resolve using the following order:

- `./index.ts`

- `./index.tsx`

- `./index.mjs`

- `./index.js`

- `./index.jsx`

- `./index.json`

- `./index.cjs`
Resolve.extensions.default.text:
`['.ts', '.tsx', '.mjs', '.js', '.jsx', '.json', '.cjs']`

例如，导入 './index' 时，Rsbuild 会按以下顺序尝试解析：

- `./index.ts`

- `./index.tsx`

- `./index.mjs`

- `./index.js`

- `./index.jsx`

- `./index.json`

- `./index.cjs`

RsdoctorRspackPluginOptions.summary.en:
Simplified options type for `tools.rsdoctor`.

Keep this type free of deeply nested/intersection utility types to ensure
typia can generate validators from `Config`.
RsdoctorRspackPluginOptions.summary.text:
`tools.rsdoctor` 的简化选项类型。

该类型应避免使用深层嵌套或交叉的工具类型，以确保
typia 能够基于 `Config` 生成校验器。

Server.base.summary.en: Configure the base path of the server.
Server.base.summary.text: 配置服务器的基础路径。

Server.base.remarks.en:
Users can access lynx bundle through `http://<host>:<port>/main.lynx.bundle` by default.

If you want to access lynx bundle through `http://<host>:<port>/foo/main.lynx.bundle`, you can change `server.base` to `/foo`

you can refer to [server.base](https://rsbuild.rs/config/server/base) for more information.
Server.base.remarks.text:
默认情况下，用户可以通过 `http://<host>:<port>/main.lynx.bundle` 访问 lynx bundle。

如果希望通过 `http://<host>:<port>/foo/main.lynx.bundle` 访问 lynx bundle，可以将 `server.base` 修改为 `/foo`。

更多信息可参考 [server.base](https://rsbuild.rs/config/server/base)。

Server.compress.summary.en: Configure whether to enable [gzip compression](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/gzip_compression) for static assets served by the dev server or preview server.
Server.compress.summary.text: 配置是否对开发服务器或预览服务器提供的静态资源启用 [gzip 压缩](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/gzip_compression)。

Server.cors.summary.en: Configure CORS for the dev server or preview server.
Server.cors.summary.text: 为开发服务器或预览服务器配置 CORS。

Server.cors.default.en:
Uses Rsbuild's default CORS options.

- Set to an object to enable CORS with the specified options.

- Set to `true` to enable CORS with the default options (allows all origins, not recommended).

- Set to `false` to disable CORS.

See [Rsbuild - server.cors](https://rsbuild.rs/config/server/cors) for details.
Server.cors.default.text:
使用 Rsbuild 默认的 CORS 选项。

- 设置为对象时，使用指定的选项启用 CORS。

- 设置为 `true` 时，使用默认选项启用 CORS（允许所有来源，不推荐）。

- 设置为 `false` 时，禁用 CORS。

详见 [Rsbuild - server.cors](https://rsbuild.rs/config/server/cors)。

Server.headers.summary.text: 为所有响应添加响应头。

Server.host.summary.en: Specify the host that the Rspeedy Server listens to.
Server.host.summary.text: 指定 Rspeedy Server 监听的 host。

Server.host.remarks.en: During `rspeedy dev`, if `server.host` is unset, the dev plugin keeps the server bound to the IPv4 wildcard address while resolving dev-server-related URLs and client host settings with a detected non-loopback IPv4 address, such as `192.168.1.50`. If no eligible IPv4 address exists, it binds to the IPv6 wildcard address and uses a detected IPv6 address for URLs. It falls back to an IPv4 loopback URL when no non-loopback IP is available. If you have multiple network interfaces, set `server.host` explicitly to choose the desired address.
Server.host.remarks.text: 在 `rspeedy dev` 期间，如果未设置 `server.host`，dev 插件会让服务器保持绑定在 IPv4 通配地址上，同时使用检测到的非回环 IPv4 地址（如 `192.168.1.50`）来解析开发服务器相关的 URL 和客户端 host 设置。如果不存在符合条件的 IPv4 地址，则绑定到 IPv6 通配地址，并使用检测到的 IPv6 地址生成 URL。当没有可用的非回环 IP 时，会回退为 IPv4 回环地址的 URL。如果你有多个网络接口，请显式设置 `server.host` 以选择所需的地址。

Server.port.summary.en: Specify the port that the Rspeedy Server listens to.
Server.port.summary.text: 指定 Rspeedy Server 监听的端口。

Server.port.remarks.en: By default, the server automatically increments the port number when the configured port is occupied.
Server.port.remarks.text: 默认情况下，当配置的端口被占用时，服务器会自动递增端口号。

Server.port.default.text: Rsbuild 默认将该选项设置为 `3000`。

Server.proxy.summary.en: Configure proxy rules for the dev server or preview server to proxy requests to the specified service.
Server.proxy.summary.text: 为开发服务器或预览服务器配置代理规则，将请求代理到指定的服务。

Server.strictPort.summary.en: When a port is occupied, Rspeedy will automatically increment the port number until an available port is found.
Server.strictPort.summary.text: 当端口被占用时，Rspeedy 会自动递增端口号，直到找到可用的端口。

Source.assetsInclude.summary.en: Include additional files that should be treated as static assets.
Source.assetsInclude.summary.text: 指定额外需要被视为静态资源的文件。

Source.assetsInclude.remarks.en:
By default, Rsbuild treats common image, font, audio, and video files as static assets.
Through the source.assetsInclude config, you can specify additional file types that should be treated as static assets.
These added static assets are processed using the same rules as the built-in supported static assets。

The usage of `source.assetsInclude` is consistent with [Condition](https://rspack.rs/config/module#condition)
in Rspack, which supports passing in strings, regular expressions, arrays of conditions, or logical conditions
to match the module path or assets.
Source.assetsInclude.remarks.text:
默认情况下，Rsbuild 会将常见的图片、字体、音频和视频文件视为静态资源。
通过 source.assetsInclude 配置，你可以指定额外需要被视为静态资源的文件类型。
这些新增的静态资源会按照与内置支持的静态资源相同的规则进行处理。

`source.assetsInclude` 的用法与 Rspack 中的 [Condition](https://rspack.rs/config/module#condition) 一致，
支持传入字符串、正则表达式、条件数组或逻辑条件，
用于匹配模块路径或资源。

Source.decorators.summary.en: Used to configure the decorators syntax.

Source.define.summary.en: The `define` options is used to define some values or expressions at compile time.
Source.define.summary.text: `define` 选项用于在编译时定义一些值或表达式。

Source.define.remarks.en:
- If the value provided is a string, it will be utilized as a code fragment.

- If the value provided is an object, all its keys will be defined in the same manner.

- If the value isn't a string, it will be stringified, with functions included.

- Notably, if a `typeof` prefix is attached to the key, it will be exclusively defined for `typeof` calls."
Source.define.remarks.text:
- 如果提供的值是字符串，它将被用作代码片段。

- 如果提供的值是对象，它的所有 key 都会以相同的方式定义。

- 如果提供的值不是字符串，它会被字符串化（包括函数）。

- 需要注意的是，如果 key 带有 `typeof` 前缀，它将只针对 `typeof` 调用进行定义。

Source.entry.summary.en: The [`Entry`](api:Entry) option is used to set the entry module.
Source.entry.summary.text: [`Entry`](api:Entry) 选项用于设置入口模块。

Source.exclude.summary.en: The `source.exclude` is used to specify JavaScript files that should be excluded from compilation.
Source.exclude.summary.text: `source.exclude` 用于指定需要从编译中排除的 JavaScript 文件。

Source.exclude.remarks.en:
By default, Rsbuild compiles JavaScript files in the current directory and TypeScript/JSX files
in all directories. Through the `source.exclude` config, you can specify files or directories
that should be excluded from compilation.
The usage of `source.exclude` is consistent with [Rule.exclude](https://rspack.rs/config/module#ruleexclude)
in Rspack, which supports passing in strings or regular expressions to match module paths.
Source.exclude.remarks.text:
默认情况下，Rsbuild 会编译当前目录下的 JavaScript 文件，
以及所有目录下的 TypeScript/JSX 文件。通过 `source.exclude` 配置，你可以指定
需要从编译中排除的文件或目录。
`source.exclude` 的用法与 Rspack 中的 [Rule.exclude](https://rspack.rs/config/module#ruleexclude) 一致，
支持传入字符串或正则表达式来匹配模块路径。

Source.include.summary.en: The `source.include` is used to specify additional JavaScript files that need to be compiled.
Source.include.summary.text: `source.include` 用于指定额外需要编译的 JavaScript 文件。

Source.include.remarks.en:
To avoid redundant compilation, by default, Rsbuild only compiles JavaScript
files in the current directory and TypeScript and JSX files in all directories.
It does not compile JavaScript files under `node_modules`.

Through the `source.include` config, you can specify directories or modules
that need to be compiled by Rsbuild.
The usage of `source.include` is consistent with [Rule.include](https://rspack.rs/config/module#ruleinclude)
in Rspack, which supports passing in strings or regular expressions to match the module path.
Source.include.remarks.text:
为了避免重复编译，默认情况下，Rsbuild 只会编译当前目录下的 JavaScript
文件以及所有目录下的 TypeScript 和 JSX 文件。
它不会编译 `node_modules` 下的 JavaScript 文件。

通过 `source.include` 配置，你可以指定
需要被 Rsbuild 编译的目录或模块。
`source.include` 的用法与 Rspack 中的 [Rule.include](https://rspack.rs/config/module#ruleinclude) 一致，
支持传入字符串或正则表达式来匹配模块路径。

Source.include.default.en: When unset, Rsbuild compiles JavaScript files in the current directory and TypeScript or JSX files in all directories, while excluding JavaScript files under `node_modules`.
Source.include.default.text: 未设置时，Rsbuild 会编译当前目录下的 JavaScript 文件以及所有目录下的 TypeScript 或 JSX 文件，同时排除 `node_modules` 下的 JavaScript 文件。

Source.preEntry.summary.en:
Add a script before the entry file of each page. This script will be executed before the page code.
It can be used to execute global logics, such as injecting polyfills, setting global styles, etc.
Source.preEntry.summary.text:
在每个页面的入口文件之前添加一段脚本。该脚本会在页面代码之前执行。
它可以用于执行全局逻辑，如注入 polyfill、设置全局样式等。

Source.transformImport.summary.en: The [`TransformImport`](api:TransformImport) option transforms the import paths to enable modular imports from subpaths of third-party packages, similar to the functionality provided by [babel-plugin-import](https://npmjs.com/package/babel-plugin-import).
Source.transformImport.summary.text: [`TransformImport`](api:TransformImport) 选项用于转换导入路径，以便从第三方包的子路径中按需导入模块，功能类似于 [babel-plugin-import](https://npmjs.com/package/babel-plugin-import)。

Source.tsconfigPath.summary.en: Configure a custom `tsconfig.json` file path to use, can be a relative or absolute path.
Source.tsconfigPath.summary.text: 配置自定义的 `tsconfig.json` 文件路径，可以是相对路径或绝对路径。

Source.tsconfigPath.remarks.en:
The `tsconfigPath` configuration affects the following behaviors:

- The `paths` field is used to configure [`Path Aliases`](api:Source.alias).

- Sets the scope and rules for the [Type Check Plugin](https://rsbuild.rs/guide/basic/typescript#type-checking).
Source.tsconfigPath.remarks.text:
`tsconfigPath` 配置会影响以下行为：

- `paths` 字段用于配置 [`Path Aliases`](api:Source.alias)。

- 设置[类型检查插件](https://rsbuild.rs/guide/basic/typescript#type-checking)的作用范围和规则。

SourceMap.css.summary.en: Whether to generate CSS source maps.
SourceMap.css.summary.text: 是否生成 CSS source map。

SourceMap.css.remarks.en:
Lynx environments enable CSS source maps so that CSS diagnostics can be
mapped back to the source; all `.map` assets are removed before emit.
SourceMap.css.remarks.text:
Lynx environment 中会启用 CSS source map，以便将 CSS 诊断信息
映射回源码；所有 `.map` 资源都会在输出前被移除。

SourceMap.css.default.text: 在 Lynx environment 中为 `true`，其他情况下为 `false`。

SourceMap.js.summary.en: How the source map should be generated. Setting it to `false` will disable the source map.
SourceMap.js.summary.text: source map 的生成方式。设置为 `false` 将禁用 source map。

SourceMap.js.default.en: When `output.sourceMap` is an object and `js` is unset, it defaults to `'cheap-module-source-map'` in development. In production, it defaults to `'source-map'` for Lynx environments and `false` otherwise.
SourceMap.js.default.text: 当 `output.sourceMap` 为对象且未设置 `js` 时，开发环境下默认为 `'cheap-module-source-map'`。生产环境下，Lynx environment 默认为 `'source-map'`，其他情况下默认为 `false`。

Tools.bundlerChain.summary.en: The [`Tools.bundlerChain`](api:Tools.bundlerChain) changes the options of [Rspack](https://rspack.rs) using [rspack-chain](https://github.com/rspack-contrib/rspack-chain).
Tools.bundlerChain.summary.text: [`Tools.bundlerChain`](api:Tools.bundlerChain) 通过 [rspack-chain](https://github.com/rspack-contrib/rspack-chain) 修改 [Rspack](https://rspack.rs) 的选项。

Tools.cssLoader.default.en: Uses defaults derived from `output.cssModules` and `output.sourceMap`, with `importLoaders` set to `1` for CSS files and `2` for Sass/Less files.
Tools.cssLoader.default.text: 使用基于 `output.cssModules` 和 `output.sourceMap` 推导出的默认值，其中 CSS 文件的 `importLoaders` 设置为 `1`，Sass/Less 文件设置为 `2`。

Tools.rsdoctor.remarks.en: Setting `RSDOCTOR=true` enables Rsdoctor. When it is enabled, Rspeedy merges additional plugin defaults during config normalization.
Tools.rsdoctor.remarks.text: 设置 `RSDOCTOR=true` 可启用 Rsdoctor。启用后，Rspeedy 会在配置规范化阶段合并额外的插件默认配置。

TransformImport.camelToDashComponentName.en: Whether to convert camelCase imports to kebab-case.
TransformImport.camelToDashComponentName.text: 是否将驼峰命名（camelCase）的导入转换为短横线命名（kebab-case）。
Rsbuild 默认将该选项设置为 `true`。

TransformImport.camelToDashComponentName.en:
- Input:

```js
import { ButtonGroup } from 'foo'
```

- Output:

When set to `true`:
```js
import ButtonGroup from 'foo/button-group'
```

When set to `false`:
```js
import ButtonGroup from 'foo/ButtonGroup'
```
TransformImport.camelToDashComponentName.text:
- 输入：

```js
import { ButtonGroup } from 'foo'
```

- 输出：

设置为 `true` 时：

```js
import ButtonGroup from 'foo/button-group'
```

设置为 `false` 时：

```js
import ButtonGroup from 'foo/ButtonGroup'
```

TransformImport.customName.remarks.en:
You you can specify the format of the transformed path.
For example, by setting it to `my-lib/{{ camelCase member }}`, you can convert the member into camelCase.

The following formats are supported:

- `kebabCase`: lowercase letters, words joined by hyphens. For example: `my-variable-name`.

- `snakeCase`: lowercase letters, words joined by underscores. For example: `my_variable_name`.

- `camelCase`: first letter lowercase, the first letter of each following word uppercase. For example: `myVariableName`.

- `upperCase`: uppercase letters, other characters unchanged. For example: `MY-VARIABLE-NAME`.

- `lowerCase`: lowercase letters, other characters unchanged. For example: `my-variable-name`.
TransformImport.customName.remarks.text:
你可以指定转换后路径的格式。
例如，将其设置为 `my-lib/{{ camelCase member }}`，即可将 member 转换为驼峰格式。

支持以下格式：

- `kebabCase`：字母小写，单词之间使用连字符连接。例如：`my-variable-name`。

- `snakeCase`：字母小写，单词之间使用下划线连接。例如：`my_variable_name`。

- `camelCase`：首字母小写，其后每个单词的首字母大写。例如：`myVariableName`。

- `upperCase`：字母大写，其他字符不变。例如：`MY-VARIABLE-NAME`。

- `lowerCase`：字母小写，其他字符不变。例如：`my-variable-name`。

TransformImport.libraryDirectory.summary.en: Used to splice the transformed path, the splicing rule is `${libraryName}/${libraryDirectory}/${member}`, where member is the imported member.
TransformImport.libraryDirectory.summary.text: 用于拼接转换后的路径，拼接规则为 `${libraryName}/${libraryDirectory}/${member}`，其中 member 为导入的成员。

TransformImport.libraryDirectory.example.en:
- Input:

```js
import { Button } from 'foo'
```

- Output:

```js
import Button from 'foo/lib/button'
```
TransformImport.libraryDirectory.example.text:
- 输入：

```js
import { Button } from 'foo'
```

- 输出：

```js
import Button from 'foo/lib/button'
```

TransformImport.libraryName.summary.en: The original import path that needs to be transformed.
TransformImport.libraryName.summary.text: 需要转换的原始导入路径。

TransformImport.transformToDefaultImport.en: Whether to convert import statements to default imports.
TransformImport.transformToDefaultImport.text: 是否将导入语句转换为默认导入。
Rsbuild 默认将该选项设置为 `true`。

TransformImport.transformToDefaultImport.en:
- Input:

```js
import { Button } from 'foo'
```

- Output:

When set to `true`:
```js
import Button from 'foo/button'
```

When set to `false`:
```js
import { Button } from 'foo/button'
```
TransformImport.transformToDefaultImport.text:
- 输入：

```js
import { Button } from 'foo'
```

- 输出：

设置为 `true` 时：

```js
import Button from 'foo/button'
```

设置为 `false` 时：

```js
import { Button } from 'foo/button'
```

BundleFilename.summary.en:
The name of the bundle files.

It can be a string with placeholders (`[name]`, `[contenthash]`,
`[platform]`), or a function that returns a string based on the
[`BundleFilenameContext`](api:BundleFilenameContext).
BundleFilename.summary.text:
bundle 文件的名称。

可以是包含占位符（`[name]`、`[contenthash]`、
`[platform]`）的字符串，也可以是一个根据
[`BundleFilenameContext`](api:BundleFilenameContext) 返回字符串的函数。

ConsoleType.summary.en: The type of the console method.

createRspeedy.summary.en: The `createRspeedy` method can let you create a Rspeedy instance and you can customize the build or development process in Node.js Runtime.
createRspeedy.summary.text: `createRspeedy` 方法用于创建一个 Rspeedy 实例，你可以借此在 Node.js 运行时中自定义构建或开发流程。

defineConfig.summary.en: The `defineConfig` method is a helper function used to get TypeScript intellisense.
defineConfig.summary.text: `defineConfig` 方法是一个辅助函数，用于获取 TypeScript 智能提示。

defineConfig.returns.en: - The identical config as the input config.
defineConfig.returns.text: - 与输入配置完全相同的配置。

loadConfig.summary.en: Load the build config by the config path.
loadConfig.summary.text: 通过配置文件路径加载构建配置。

mergeRspeedyConfig.summary.text: 合并多个 Rspeedy 配置对象。

mergeRspeedyConfig.remarks.en: This is actually an alias of [mergeRsbuildConfig](https://rsbuild.rs/api/javascript-api/core#mergersbuildconfig).
mergeRspeedyConfig.remarks.text: 它实际上是 [mergeRsbuildConfig](https://rsbuild.rs/api/javascript-api/core#mergersbuildconfig) 的别名。

mergeRspeedyConfig.returns.text: 合并后的 Rspeedy 配置对象。
